A Scientific Advisory Board consisting of leading fertility clinicians advise the company.

aiResearchSummary.text: Hannah Life Technologies is engaged in research and development of devices and methods for aiding conception, as described in 'Devices and methods for aiding conception.' The abstract details a conception aid designed for placement in the vaginal canal, featuring capturing elements to collect semen, and outlines a method for using such a device to assist natural conception. Their work focuses on improving accessibility and effectiveness of infertility treatments.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $5,150,000, or 72.03% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,606,229 to $30,591,481, a 6.64x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
